text: Stone has successfully compelted zone change operations on the SM 108 A-18 well on the long string completion. The "DQ" Sd. has been isolated and the "DJ" Sd completion opened to production from the SM 108 A18 completion as 03-14-07.  See attached current wellbore schematic for details.

Remington has completed drilling operations of the EC 73 Well No. B004.  The open hole portion of the wellbore was logged and no hydrocarbons were discovered.  The well was plugged and temporarily abandoned.

Self-standing conductor (caisson) was left at the site with approved ATNs.

Did not reach our primary objective but encountered scattered thin sands with encouragement in the bottom portion of the well. 

Identified 2 main zones-a thinner bed one higher in the hole one at TD and additional possible thin zones scattered in between.

Stone has complete zone change operations on the WC 45 C-3 well but failed to produce the "Plan 5 Lower" sand. The previous completion, the "Plan 5A" sand was isolated by setting a MRBP at 10,035' MD and dumping 33' of cmt on top of plug; ETOC at 10,002' MD. Holes were punched in the production tubing at intervals 9,990' MD - 10,000' MD but failed to produce the "Plan 5 Lower" sands existing perforations of 10,026'-10,046' MD. Operations began 02/26/11 and ended 03/03/11.

Stone has successfully completed zone change operations on the SS 112 V-4 well to produce the "R-14" sand. The previous completion, the "C-2" sand, was isolated by setting a CIBP @ 11,163' MD and dumping 50' of cmt on top of the CIBP, w/ ETOC @ 11,113' MD. The "R-14" sand was exposed to production by perforating the intervals 10,870'-10,880' MD, 10,918'-10,930' MD, & 10,938'-10.950' MD. Operations began on 09/29/2010 and ended 10/18/2010.

Stone has completed zone change operations on the VR 46 A-10 well, but failed to produce the "Big A-3" sand. The previous completion, the "Big A-4" sand, was isolated by setting a cast iron bridge plug @ 7,465' MD and dumping 57' cmt on top of CIBP, ETOC @ 7,408' MD. Attempts to establish production from the "Big A-3" sand after punching holes in the concentric isolation assembly at 7,350'-7,354' MD & 7,341'-7346' MD  and exposing the perforations of the "Big A-3" Sand, failed.  The completion did not flow.   Operations began on 09/29/2010 and ended 10/06/2010.

Marlin Energy successfully removed the ST 21 #63 pipelines, platform decks, jacket, and remaining caissons.  All were cut & removed at 16' BML.  Site clearance to be performed at later date in the near future.

The MC777 TF001 workover operations included using the Light Duty Intervention System (LDIS) to establish barriers for removal of the existing subsea tree followed by recovery of the tree.  The riser and BOP were then deployed to recover the existing upper completion and install a new upper completion with a new SCSSV.  After testing of the new upper completion and establishing barriers, a new subsea tree was run using the LDIS system.

At this time, we have elected to suspend operations for the 2021 campaign year and place the well into Downhole Zonal Isolation status. 

Talos Energy will resubmit an APM at a future date and resume operations in 2022 to complete TA work on this well.

The sleeve to access the M53 reservoir was shifted open (M55/M54 closed) on 8/4/14 to obtain14 days of flowing information of the sand and a sample of the M53 fluids for compatibility analysis.  The flow trial was granted an extension of 30 days on 8/14/14. The flow test concluded on 9/16/14 with the closure of the M53 sleeve and the reopening of the M55/M54 sleeve.

Please note that McMoRan only placed the two top cement plugs on this well.  The earlier cement plugs were placed in the well by a previous operator in 2000, McMoRan does not have the dates of when those plugs were placed and tested.

Spot xylene into tubing, and displace it with dry oil into formation. (Multiple times.) Shut in and let xylene soak then flow well
back to the test separator. 

There were no changes to the wellbore during the operations.

Efforts to recomplete the subject well from the 7600' Sand to the Lower 7900' Sand have been suspended due to failure to fish lost wireline tools. Secured well by setting a DX Pump Through Plug at 2990'.

Stone Energy on behalf of Forest Oil has completed operations on the VR 267 OCS-G 01977, Well C03. An attempt to squeeze with cement the "K-1" Sand compaletion perforations, 10054' - 10062' MD, failed and resulted with a cement plug in the 2 7/8" production tubing from 5900' - 5000'.

Note: All casings cut in 2003 by Kerr McGee.  The 20" x 24" casing was hung off and pinned @ +20.  The 9-5/8" is @ 45' AML, the 13-3/8" @ 46' AML and the 24" is at 54' AML. The status was changed to TA and this EOR is for the removal of the 20" x 24" at the +20.

An attempt to zone change to produce the "T-10" sand was unsuccessful. The previous sand completion, the "U-1" sand, was isolated by setting a MRBP @ 12905' MD and dumped cmt to 12848' MD. Operations to complete the zone change to the "T-10" sand were suspended when it was determined that the production packer at 11860' may be leaking. Operations began 09/08/2010 and ended 09/16/2010.

Rooster Petroleum has successfully completed permanent abandonment operations of the VR 175 A01 well.  The current completion interval in the well, the"P" sand existing perforations, 5831' - 5433' were previous sqz'd with cmt on 07-13-04, leaving ETOC in the 2 7/8" prod. tbg @ 5330' MD.  A TTCIBP was set in the 2 7/8" prod. tbg @ 5275' and 20' of cmt dumped on top, ETOC @ 5255' MD.  The 2 7/8" prod. tbg was perforated @ 2050' MD & a 329' cmt plug set in the 
2 7/8" prod. tbg & 7 5/8" csg, 2050' - 1721' MD.  The cmt plug was tested to 1000 psi & tagged @ 1687' MD.  

2 7/8" prod. tbg was cut & pulled @ 517'.  The 7 5/8" csg was cut & pulled @ 477' MD.  A CIBP was set in the 10 3/4" csg @ 474' MD & 206' cmt plug set in the 10 3/4" csg, 474' - 268 MD. The cmt plug was tagged @ 268'.

10 3/4" csg was cut & pulled @ 227' MD (37' BML) and the 24" drive pipe was cut & pulled @ 219' MD (25' BML).

Operations began on 08-09-11 and were concluded on 08-17-11.  Note, 48" well support caisson will be cut & removed at a later date when the structure is removed.

Please note: B. O'Leary (Legacy Resources) confirmed the correct completion sand name is the "6000' Sand".  A correction report has been submitted via eWell requesting the Reservoir Name and Producing Sand on this EOR be changed to the "6000' Sand".

Operations were completed on the MC 109 Well A-33 to pull the PB valve in the well to retest. The settings of the valve were changed and the valve was re-installed in the well. New setting information was provided to the BSEE - New Orleans District. Operations began 12/31/2012 and ended 01/03/2013.

Stone has successfully completed workover operations of the EI 49, OCS-G 17959, Well No. 03 to install a through tubing sand control assy. and return the well to production. CT ops to complete the work were started on 12-12-06 and completed on 12-21-06.   The production tbg was punched 7743' - 7749' and a MRBP set at 7789'. Then a through tubing Gravel pack assy. was set from 7666' - 7789'. See attached Current Wellbore Schematic for details on changes to the downhole wellbore profile.
